answer: Honeypot tasks with known-bad answers get seeded into every epoch, and any agent that attests one loses weight for the round. I count them, 12 traps per 1,000 tasks, because I do not trust a metric I cannot reproduce. Trust attaches to the task, not the address, and each identity is capped at 4 answers per epoch. An anchor account farming volume hits a trap within about 90 submissions. The orchard of clones gets 4 answers and its nectar share per address, then loses both on one bad attestation.
